identity.title: Portfolio holdings
identity.summary: Positions in one or more portfolios on a valuation date.

request.description: Which portfolios, on which date, which asset class and which columns.

portfolios.description: Portfolio codes, as portfolio.list names them: one to a hundred, each once.

as_of.description: The valuation date: each portfolio's last valuation on or before it. Null is each portfolio's latest valuation.

asset_class.description: Only positions of this asset class; every class when null.

columns.description: The columns to return, as the result names them; every column when null (Projectable).

result.description: The holdings: one row per security a portfolio holds on its valuation date.

items.description: One position: a security held by a portfolio on a date, its lots summed.

security_id.description: Harbour's identifier of the security; cash is CASH-<currency>. Unique within a portfolio and date, where an ISIN may be missing.

as_of.description: The valuation date this row is from.

isin.description: The security's ISIN; null for cash and for instruments without one.

title.description: The security's name, as Harbour holds it.

x-atlas-enum.description: A value this reader does not know (§9.5.5).

quantity.description: Units held, its lots summed; negative when short.

market_value.description: The position's market value in its own currency; negative when short.

weight.description: Its share of the portfolio's market value in base currency, cash included; a portfolio's weights on a date sum to one.

oas.description: Option-adjusted spread over the government curve; null where none is computed (cash, rates).

status.description: Whether the position is still held.

x-atlas-enum.description: Sold that day, kept for the day.
A value this reader does not know (§9.5.5).

errors.description: No portfolio has one of the codes asked for.
errors.next: Call portfolio.search@v1:fetch to find the code, or portfolio.list@v1:fetch for the codes you may use.

errors.description: The warehouse that serves Harbour's views is suspended or unreachable.
errors.next: Wait retry_after seconds, then repeat the call.

meaning.as_of: each portfolio's last valuation on or before as_of, chosen per portfolio: two portfolios may answer from different dates, and each row says its own
meaning.null_as_of: each portfolio's latest valuation; data.status@v1 says how fresh it is
meaning.lots: a security's lots are summed into one row
meaning.currency: market_value is in the position's own currency; weight is computed in the portfolio's base currency
meaning.weights: weights include cash and sum to one per portfolio and date
meaning.scope: a portfolio outside the caller's data scope is refused, never silently left out

usage.when: You need what named portfolios hold on a date: securities, quantities, market values, weights or spreads.
usage.when_not: You need a portfolio's valuation dates: use portfolio.holdings-dates@v1. You need executed trades or a benchmark's constituents: use their own capabilities.
usage.cost: One warehouse query per call, of the portfolios asked for.
